player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Wild Tic Tac Toe.
On your turn, you can place either an 'X' or an 'O' in an empty square.
You win by aligning three of the same mark (X or O) in a row.
You can win with either symbol.
Choose your move using the format '[X 4]' to place X in the center.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mikaro si sahihi. Tumia fomu '[X 4]' au '[O 2]'.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Namba ya kĩhumo ĩtarĩ njagĩrĩru: {cell} No mũhaka akorũo ĩrĩ gatagatĩ ka 0 na 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Kũthama gũtarĩ kĩguni. Gĩcunjĩ {cell} nĩ gĩakinyĩrĩte mũndũ ũngĩ.

game_action.placed: Mwari {player_id} amwekire symbol yake ({mark}) kwa seli {cell}
